description: Repo hygiene: the four repo-owned files README.md names as its T1 item 10 inventory, backed by the three dependency-free gates of .github/workflows/ci.yml. check-ci.sh is pinned because it holds the bytes of those three gates, so a weakening edit to a stage function fails the attestations stage until item 10 is re-minted. Each gate fails when a committed artifact drifts from the generator or config that produced it, so none of them can pass vacuously. Resync-managed paths (.gitignore, .loom/, .claude/, CLAUDE.md) are deliberately not listed -- see klt signoff docs, 'what belongs in a hygiene inventory'. One envelope serves both partitions.
